source_snapshot.scope: Read-only template, layout, style, and intermediate-representation source study.

boundary_cases.source_evidence: The fixed snapshot uses both four-column and five-column roster rows; report_core includes a Master column.
boundary_cases.observation: All 86 SVG assets resolve to a roster row, page type, picker name, and purpose.
Both Blank prototypes have zero slots; the source contract permits zero-slot pages, so no placeholder was invented.
Each explicit slot has numeric bounds. Design Spec token lists are recorded separately because the source does not define a universal one-to-one token-to-slot binding or maximum character/line count.
The map records selection source, creation strategy, reuse scope, adherence, and flat/structured applicability. It preserves explicit-only metadata rules and does not infer layout assignment.

failure_case.observed_error: Unmapped layout assets: 13 report_core SVG roster rows were not associated.
failure_case.block_reason: The first parser assumed every roster had four columns; report_core adds a Master column.
failure_case.resolution: The generator now supports both roster shapes. The rerun passed with zero unmapped SVGs.
failure_case.scope: The failed assertion occurred before writing the map; it did not modify the upstream source or product runtime.

limitations: The map describes PPT Master source assets; it does not claim YoloongPPT has implemented these assets or selected this architecture.
Slot bounds describe geometric capacity zones. The source does not provide a universal maximum text length or line count, so those limits remain undefined.
No universal normalized IR combines the Markdown Design Spec, spec_lock contract, per-page SVG metadata, and optional native visualization payloads.
No product generation, full template render, Office round-trip, Docker application service, or AC-001–AC-030 test was run for this source-mapping task.
